name: hunt_pb_ema15_first

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (angle: pullbacks in the day trend): the first pullback of a session pass to the 15-minute EMA(20) in the direction of a rising (falling) EMA(50): a 15-minute bar that dips through the EMA(20) and closes back over it, while the EMA(50) slopes up, buys at its close; the mirror sells. 35-point stop, 1:1.5. Why it should pay: in a trending session the 5-hour mean of 15-minute closes is where the trend's holders add; a bar that trades through it and closes back on the trend side shows the dip was bought. Who loses: the sellers who broke the mean and are trapped when the bar closes back above it.

entry.words: NQ 15-minute bars. When the EMA(50) of 15-minute closes is rising (above its value one bar before) and a bar's low trades at or under the EMA(20) and the bar closes above it, buy at the close by market order; when the EMA(50) is falling and a bar's high trades at or over the EMA(20) and it closes below, sell. Stop 35 points, target 52.5 points (1:1.5). The first such bar of each session pass only (one trade a pass), flat 15:58.

not_run: THE EMAs: the Template's own, on 15-minute closes since 00:00 ET, seeded with the day's first close (an EMA(50) at 10:00 rests on about 40 bars); the slope is the EMA(50) now vs one bar before.
THE STOP is fixed in points (the family's structure stop, the pullback bar's extreme, is not used).

CAPPED PER SESSION PASS, NOT PER DAY: nyam, mid and pm are three passes, so a day can hold up to 3 trades and a trade of one pass may still be open when another pass enters; 'first tag' means the first of each pass.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage on market and stop fills, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); no entry in the last 5 minutes of a pass.
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only; the 3:1 block walk-forward comes later under PREREG.
